description: Search for products across configured Swiss grocery chains (Migros, Coop, Aldi, Denner, Lidl) by keyword. Supports optional filters for price, size range, and product tags (organic, vegan, budget, etc.). Returns results grouped by chain with normalised price, unit price, size, and promotion info. A `sources` map reports each chain's data freshness (fetchedAt timestamp + fromCache flag) so you can tell the user how current the prices are. Use for "find organic milk under 2 CHF", "compare pasta prices", or "search for gluten-free bread".

inputSchema.description: Search for products across configured Swiss grocery chains by keyword, with optional price, size, and tag filters. Returns results grouped by chain.

chains.description: Restrict search to specific chains. Omit to search all configured chains in parallel.

filters.description: Optional product filters applied after search.

maxPrice.description: Maximum product price in CHF (inclusive), e.g. 3.5.

sizeRange.description: Size range filter in millilitres; useful for beverages and liquids.

tags.description: Product tags to filter by, e.g. ["organic", "vegan"]. All tags must match.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per chain (1–50). Defaults to chain-specific limit.

offset.description: Skip the first N results per chain. Use with `limit` to paginate. Default 0.

query.description: Search term in any language, e.g. "Milch", "pâtes", "Bier". At least 1 character.

storeIds.description: Filter results to products available in these store IDs (chain-specific internal IDs).

name: search_products
